no-pl.what: the shift without its second constant: t = RN64(PH - |x|). NOT known false: MEASURED on 68,001 inputs, 8,001 of them around the binary32 pi/2, 0 not faithful (without PL the shifted argument is off by 6.1e-17, at most 1.4e-9 of it, under the 7.45e-9 the route allows). Refused only by the route of the proof: the shift no longer has the two roundings the proof walks

ph-ulp.what: PH one unit in the last place up. NOT known false: MEASURED on the same 68,001 inputs, 0 not faithful (the shifted argument is off by 2.2e-16, at most 5.1e-9 of it). Refused where PH + PL must lie within 2^-60 of PI/2: the planted sum is 2^-52 away

ph-binary32.what: PH is the binary32 number nearest pi/2 (a shift done with a binary32 constant). KNOWN FALSE, MEASURED: at x = 3FC90FDB the planted graph gives 248D3132 (about 6.1e-17, the constant PL alone) and cos x lies between B33BBD2F and B33BBD2E (about -4.37e-8). Refused where PH + PL must lie within 2^-60 of PI/2

plus-for-minus.what: the shift is PH + |x| for PH - |x| (x + pi/2: the argument leaves sin32's interval). KNOWN FALSE, MEASURED: at x = 3 (40400000) the planted graph gives BF7D8CF0 and cos 3 lies between BF7D7026 and BF7D7025. Refused where the proof meets the shift

hand-edited-graph.what: Graph.v with one blank added at the end of a line: the same graph for Coq, and not what emit_cos32.py prints

prem-no-cmax.what: COS32 without |x| <= CMAX. KNOWN FALSE, MEASURED: at x = 8 (41000000) the graph gives BC0989CE and cos 8 lies between BE14FDF6 and BE14FDF5. Refused where the proof takes the premise

prem-cmax-2x.what: CMAX doubled (about 2 pi). KNOWN FALSE, MEASURED: at x = 6 (40C00000) the graph gives 3F75DEA5 and cos 6 lies between 3F75CDB8 and 3F75CDB9. Refused where the proof needs |PI/2 - |x|| <= 63/40

prem-finite-no-cmax.what: COS32_FINITE without |x| <= CMAX. False, ARGUED and not evaluated: the model has no overflow, and at x = 2^127 the shifted argument is about -2^127 and the polynomial is of the order of its 14th power, far above FMAX32. Refused where the proof takes the premise

concl-round-down.what: COS32 says the result is cos x rounded DOWN. KNOWN FALSE, MEASURED: at x = 3F800001 the graph gives 3F0A513F and cos x rounded down is 3F0A513E. Refused where lemma F32 no longer fits

concl-correct.what: COS32 claims the correctly rounded result. KNOWN FALSE, MEASURED (measure-correct-run1.txt): at x = 3D4CF17D the graph gives 3F7FADFB and the correctly rounded cos x is 3F7FADFC (the first such input found going up from 3D4CCCCD, after 9,393; none in 2,000,000 going up from 1). Refused where lemma F32 no longer fits

concl-finite-half.what: COS32_FINITE says the result is at most 1/2 in magnitude. KNOWN FALSE, MEASURED: at x = 0 (00000000) the graph gives 1 (3F800000). Refused where faithful_finite no longer fits

admitted.what: Cos32.sin_abs_le (|sin h| <= |h| (1 + 2^-37)) ends with Admitted for its last step

pi-axiom.what: the lower bound on pi, pi_lo, is an Axiom of PiBound.v (the same text, its proof removed), used by the top theorem through pi_fact

other-statement.what: Cos32.v states, under the name COS32_ALL, the proposition True and proves that

guard.what: cos32_all from False, by a recursion whose termination check is switched off
